5.5.title: Decommissioning and Disposal Procedure
5.5.text:
• Plant must be decommissioned, dismantled, or disposed of in accordance with
manufacturer guidance and risk assessments, and
• Relevant safety information must be provided to parties involved in dismantling or
transfer of ownership.

5.2.title: Operation and Supervision of Plant and Equipment Procedure
5.2.text:
• Documented operating procedures must be implemented where identified by risk
assessment
• Plant must be operated only within its design limits and intended use, and
• Impaired or damaged plant must be withdrawn from service immediately.

4.1.2.title: Operators of Plant and Equipment
4.1.2.text:
Operators of Plant and Equipment are required to:

• Conduct required pre-use checks
• Operate plant in accordance with procedures, and
• Report defects and unsafe conditions immediately.

5.4.title: Removal from Service Procedure
5.4.text:
• Plant identified as unsafe must be isolated, tagged, and removed from service until
made safe, and
• Controls must be implemented to prevent unintended use of defective plant.

4.2.1.title: Operators of Plant and Equipment
4.2.1.text:
Operators of Plant and Equipment are required to:

• Hold a current and valid license appropriate to the Plant and Equipment being operated,
and
• Complete the Plant and Equipment Training Module (IMS.03.17.TRN.01) annually.

5.3.title: Inspection and Maintenance Procedure
5.3.text:
• Audit, Inspection, Monitoring and Testing requirements shall be adhered to as per the
Audit, Inspection, Monitoring and Testing Management Procedure (IMS.07.01.PRO.01).

4.1.title: Specific Roles and Responsibilities Related to this Procedure
4.1.text:
4.1.1. Leaders
All Leaders are responsible for:

• Ensuring plant is fit for purpose and safely operated, and
• Verifying competency, licensing, inspection, and maintenance requirements are met.
4.1.2. Operators of Plant and Equipment
Operators of Plant and Equipment are required to:

• Conduct required pre-use checks
• Operate plant in accordance with procedures, and
• Report defects and unsafe conditions immediately.

4.2.title: Competency Requirements
4.2.text:
4.2.1. Operators of Plant and Equipment
Operators of Plant and Equipment are required to:

• Hold a current and valid license appropriate to the Plant and Equipment being operated,
and
• Complete the Plant and Equipment Training Module (IMS.03.17.TRN.01) annually.

5.1.3.title: Risk Assessment and Control Procedure
5.1.3.text:
• A risk assessment must be completed before first use, modification, relocation, or
change in operating conditions. This shall be recorded using IMS Risk Assessment Form
(IMS.03.00.FRM.01) as per the Risk Management Procedure (IMS.03.00.PRO.01)
• Controls must be selected and implemented in accordance with the hierarchy of control
• Risk assessments must be reviewed when new hazard information becomes available
• Audit, Inspection, Monitoring and Testing requirements shall be identified and adhered to
as per the Audit, Inspection, Monitoring and Testing Management Procedure
(IMS.07.01.PRO.01), and
• Competency requirements shall be ascertained and managed as per the Competency
Management Procedure (IMS.04.01.PRO.01)

5.1.2.title: Pre Purchase Procedure
5.1.2.text:
• Prior to purchasing or hiring plant and equipment, hazards and risks associated with its
lifecycle must be identified and documented via the Plant and Equipment Risk
Assessment Form (IMS.03.17.FRM.01)
• Plant must comply with applicable legislation, standards, and manufacturer
specifications
• Second-hand plant must not be commissioned until all safety-critical defects are rectified

4.1.1.title: Leaders
4.1.1.text:
All Leaders are responsible for:

• Ensuring plant is fit for purpose and safely operated, and
• Verifying competency, licensing, inspection, and maintenance requirements are met.

5.1.4.title: Approval For Use Procedure
5.1.4.text:
Plant and equipment must not be used until :

• The risk assessment has been approved as per the Risk Management Procedure
(IMS.03.00.PRO.01)
• Required inspections, controls, and registrations are confirmed, and
• Leaders have verified operator competency and licensing prior to authorising use.

5.1.1.title: Identification and Registration Procedure
5.1.1.text:
• All changes to plant and equipment used in operations must be identified and assessed
to determine whether it requires inclusion in a Plant and Equipment Register. This shall
be done as per Change Risk Management Procedure (IMS.03.01.PRO.01)
• Plant requiring inspection, maintenance, or registration must be recorded in the register
prior to use, and
• High-risk plant must not be used unless registered with the relevant authority where
required by legislation.
